hooks.name: Quality Gate Reminder on Session Stop
hooks.description: Reminds the agent to run quality checks after completing a coding session

action.prompt: The session is ending. If any source files were modified during this session, remind the user to run the following quality gates before opening a PR: (1) npm test -- --run, (2) npm run typecheck, (3) npm run lint, (4) npm audit --audit-level=high. List the specific commands they should run. Keep the message brief.
